verdict.rationale: Users can delete their own data: the official CLI supports deleting vaults and individual items (passwords, notes, cards, identities, SSH keys), and they can export data as encrypted JSON, unencrypted ZIP, or CSV before removing it. Nothing in the evidence covers retention controls or policies, or what happens to deleted data on Proton's servers. Missing for 10: documented retention policy/periods, account-level deletion, trash/purge behavior, server-side deletion guarantees, independent corroboration.
